item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:35 HKT 02/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, the weather will become cool over Guangdong in the next couple of days. An upper-air disturbance will also bring rainy weather to the region. Under the influence of a relatively dry replenishment of the monsoon, the weather will improve gradually in the latter part of this week and over the weekend.

Date/Month: 03/03 (Tuesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers and isolated thunderstorms. Becoming cool.
Temp range: 17 - 22 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
